query: Since 2 June 2017, The Leader of Fine Gael had been held by which Irish Fine Gael politician who has served as Taoiseach and Minister for Defence?

pipeline_result.response: Leo Varadkar is the Irish Fine Gael politician who has served as both the Taoiseach (Prime Minister) and Minister for Defence since 2 June 2017. He also holds the position of Leader of Fine Gael, having held this role since then following the resignation of Enda Kenny.
retrieved_context: Leader of Fine Gael: The Leader of Fine Gael is the most senior politician within the Fine Gael political party in Ireland.  Since 2 June 2017, the office had been held by Leo Varadkar following the resignation of Enda Kenny.

Leo Varadkar: Leo Eric Varadkar ( ; Irish: "Leo de Varad" ;born 18 January 1979) is an Irish Fine Gael politician who has served as Taoiseach, Minister for Defence and Leader of Fine Gael since June 2017.  He has been a Teachta Dála (TD) since 2007, currently for the Dublin West constituency.  He previously served as Minister for Social Protection from 2016 to 2017, Minister for Health from 2014 to 2016 and Minister for Transport, Tourism and Sport from 2011 to 2014.
